WITH store AS (
  SELECT store_id, record_path
  FROM stores
  WHERE city = 'Linz'
    AND (store_name LIKE '%hardware%' OR store_name = 'Central Linz Hardware')
  LIMIT 1
),
product_1 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Tork'
    AND pv.series = 'Tork Wiping W'
    AND pv.model = '2RU-ZDO'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaning_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'sponge')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'pack_count' AND pvp.property_value_text = '3 pcs')
),
product_2 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Sikkens'
    AND pv.series = 'Sikkens Exterior SIK ZRP-H5X'
    AND pv.model = 'ZRP-H5X'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'product_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wood sealer')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'color_family' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'Brown')
),
product_3 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Sikkens'
    AND pv.series = 'Sikkens Exterior Cetol 3CU-TSJ'
    AND pv.model = '3CU-TSJ'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'product_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wood stain')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'color_family' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'White')
),
product_4 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Bernardo'
    AND pv.series = 'Bernardo Professional TK 2DM-OB7'
    AND pv.model = '2DM-OB7'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'machine_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'bench grinder')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '230 V')
),
product_5 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Michelin'
    AND pv.series = 'Michelin Compact Radius ONB-OGX'
    AND pv.model = 'ONB-OGX'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'product_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'battery charger')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '12 V')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'current' AND pvp.property_value_text = '4 A')
),
product_6 AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Karcher'
    AND pv.series = 'Karcher Professional WD 1V2-NV2'
    AND pv.model = '1V2-NV2'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'glass cleaner')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_text = '2500 ml')
),
all_products AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_6
),
inventory_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM all_products ap
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = ap.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE si.available_today_quantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT record_path FROM store) AS store_record_path,
  (SELECT cnt FROM inventory_count) AS count,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_1) AS p1_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_1) AS p1_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_2) AS p2_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_2) AS p2_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_3) AS p3_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_3) AS p3_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_4) AS p4_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_4) AS p4_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_5) AS p5_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_5) AS p5_record_path,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM product_6) AS p6_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM product_6) AS p6_record_path;
